metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented and verified the C++20 `ical` CLI.

Files:

- [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt)
- [main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp)

Build from `/workspace/output`:

```bash
cmake -B build
cmake --build build
```

Both `parse` and `expand` were exercised across recurrence, timezone/DST, overrides, iTIP, availability, malformed-input, and warning cases. Clean builds and sanitizer checks pass.

Unsupported non-Gregorian CLDR scales use RFC 7529’s non-recurring compatibility fallback and emit `rscale_unsupported`; Gregorian `RSCALE`/`SKIP` is expanded.

editorial.last_message: Claims implemented; unchanged source scores 464/467 under corrected ICal 3.0.4. Build and sanitizer smoke checks pass. Two EXRULE observations and a missing ADD prohibition remain; local checks mainly verify execution and JSON syntax.
editorial.notes:
Tests-only ICal 3.0.4 regrade of unchanged preserved gpt-5.6-sol Max ical-cpp source. The preceding 3.0.3 publication and current grade both score 464/467, without skips or errors. All 460 unaffected outcomes and all seven changed-case outcomes are identical for this source; two renamed cases are explicitly mapped. Three invalid component-free positive fixtures now contain a valid VTIMEZONE or VEVENT. Orphan diagnostics may appear during parse or bounded expand, without requiring todo/journal occurrence output; missing both still fails. The isolated ADD prohibition requires kind/method/component while avoiding the ambiguous unlisted RECURRENCE-ID property metadata value. These changes leave all 28 assembled model inputs and reference code unchanged. The unchanged reference passes 467/467. A combined permitted-policy control changes from 0/7 on prior tests to 7/7; four independent negative controls retain their exact intended failures without schema amplification. Independent author, authority and patch/control reviews checked the correction; root verified sequential pinned-image regrading and preservation. Remaining failed nodes: test_adversarial_corners.py::test_exrule_monthly_second_friday; test_adversarial_corners.py::test_exrule_combined_with_exdate; test_itip_methods_deep.py::test_add_forbids_recurrence_id. Failure observations are not independent bug counts. Earlier source/transcript/final-claim reviews remain applicable to the unchanged generation; their complete publication payloads and linked audit history remain preserved. The 3.0.3 cancellation/alarm correction remains in force. Original metadata, raw score, source/transcript/session hashes and input/output/cache/reasoning usage are retained. Tool-call accounting is rechecked from preserved evidence; unavailable counts remain unavailable. Reasoning is an output subset and is not charged twice. The retained API-equivalent estimate is not a subscription charge. Regrading makes no model calls and adds no generation cost.

Run conditions: apps explicitly disabled in the recorded launch; no external tool invocation observed.
